newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strasbourg Jan-Oct air cargo traffic up 10.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Strasbourg Jan-Oct air cargo traffic up 10.3 pct.

text.p: Air cargo traffic handled at Strasbourg-Entzheim Airport in the first ten months of the year, totalled 5,664 tonnes, up 10.3 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.

Air Jet, airline subsidiary of French express distribution company, Jet Services, operates a nightly air cargo service between Strasbourg and Paris/Charles de Gaulle with British Aerospace BAe146QC (quick change) aircraft.
The Alsace airport also features on Air Jet's Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille- Paris/CDG itinerary.
January-October 1996 postal traffic handled at Strasbourg totalled 4,265 tonnes, a decrease of 2.6 percent on 1995 levels.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-CDG hub and Strasbourg on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
